description_en: Queries the feature configurations of a site. You can query all feature configurations of a site or specify FunctionName to query a specific feature configuration
description_zh: 查询站点功能配置，可以查询站点下所有的功能配置，也可以传FunctionName指定查询某一项功能配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-site-functions --site-id 340035003106221 --function-name CacheRules --config-id 352816096987136 --config-type rule --rule-name test --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --site-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSiteFunctions

parameters.description_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en: The function name of the feature.
parameters.help_en: The function name of the feature
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.description_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:
- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, both global and rule configurations are returned. This parameter takes effect only when the FunctionName parameter is specified.
parameters.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
- global：查询全局配置；
- rule：查询规则配置；

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置。此参数只有在传了functionName参数时才会生效。
